responsibility: Objective-C front-end language hook registration file. It defines the language kind as clk_objc, instantiates the lang_hooks table for GNU Objective-C, and binds the Objective-C-specific initialization, printable-name, gimplify, tree-node initialization/sizing, and SARIF source-language callbacks while relying on shared C/ObjC hooks from c-objc-common for the rest of the language interface.
